summary: Troopers say a felony DUI charge filed Oct. 25 followed a crash on Chena Pump Road and a breath test of .272. Fairbanks police arrested Adam Jarrod Dennis on Kellum Street early Oct. 25; he faces escape and assault charges. Police arrested Samuel Jasiel Benjamin Malone twice on Oct. 25, once on a felony indecent exposure charge. The court system's closed-case list records 18 Interior cases closed Oct. 20 to 25, one by guilty plea. The weekly charges report for Oct. 19 to 25 lists 40 new criminal cases at Fairbanks and one at Nenana.

entries.title: Felony DUI: Nicholas John Pederson
body: Nicholas John Pederson is charged with felony driving under the influence, a Class C felony. That means drunk driving with two or more prior convictions, punishable by up to five years.
Troopers say they were called to a crash on Chena Pump Road at about 11:15 p.m. on Oct. 24 and that he gave a breath sample of .272 after his arrest.
Alaska State Troopers; case 4FA-26-02159CR, preliminary hearings Nov. 3 and Nov. 12.

entries.title: Trespass arrest: Gilbert Abraham Frank
body: Gilbert Abraham Frank was arrested on Oct. 24 on a trespass report. The court file opened that day does not yet list a charge.
Troopers say he refused to leave the Aspen Suites on Old Airport Road when the manager on duty ordered him out, at about 3:45 a.m.
Alaska State Troopers; case 4FA-26-02152CR, arraignment Oct. 30.

sources.label: Alaska Court System weekly charges report

entries.title: Escape and assault arrest: Adam Jarrod Dennis
body: Adam Jarrod Dennis, 41, is charged with second-degree escape, a Class B felony, and third-degree assault, a Class C felony recorded as domestic violence. Escape means leaving official custody; it carries up to 10 years.
Fairbanks police arrested him at the 1000 block of Kellum Street at 4:49 a.m. on Oct. 25, police case 26003271.

entries.title: Indecent exposure arrests: Samuel Jasiel Benjamin Malone
body: Samuel Jasiel Benjamin Malone, 30, was arrested twice on Oct. 25 by Fairbanks police.

The first arrest, at 3:22 p.m. at the 2400 block of Bjerremark Street, was on stalking and indecent exposure charges recorded by police as misdemeanors. The second, at 8:12 p.m. at Airport Way and Peger Road, was on a first-degree indecent exposure charge recorded by police as a felony, and violating conditions of release.
Police cases 26003275 and 26003279; no court case has been opened yet.

entries.title: Court closures: 18 Interior cases closed Oct. 20–25
body: The Alaska Court System's dispositions list records 18 criminal cases closed at Fairbanks, Nenana and Delta Junction between Oct. 20 and Oct. 25.

Shad Warren Wood pleaded guilty on Oct. 21 to attempted tampering with physical evidence, case 4FA-26-00725CR. Of the rest, 12 were dismissed by prosecutors or in the furtherance of justice, three were dismissed after a finding of incompetency and three were closed with no charging document filed.
